search_window.basis: Previous durable and verified hourly Care Line Watch heartbeat completion to current observation. Recency-limited supplementary recall, not primary collection.

coverage_notes.scope: All U.S. states, District of Columbia and U.S. territories: hospital/ED/maternity/behavioral-health/dialysis/oncology/primary-care loss, emergency or rural service loss, EMS or air-medical/base closure, official CMS termination/rescission/CLIA action and concrete essential-service restoration.

coverage_notes.screening: No new, corroborated, nonduplicate healthcare-access changes for this hourly interval were established. Search results predominantly concerned previously reported closures, policy discussions and general healthcare trends; foreign cases were excluded.

duplicate_review.reference: Winchester Family Medicine, NH November 6 primary-care closure was reported October 16, 2026; the October 16 ledger explicitly excluded it as pre-existing to that hourly window. Thus this result is not newly reported and must not be reintroduced as a fresh finding.
duplicate_review.production_review: Production Care Line collector and any unpublished review queue remain authoritative; complete historical production de-duplication was not performed.

coverage_notes.timeliness: Started approximately 17m51s after the scheduled 06:45:22 PDT time; search window begins at the prior verified heartbeat completion, avoiding an unsearched interval.
coverage_notes.limitations: Time-lagged indexing and sparse early-morning local coverage may obscure new developments. A no-findings outcome means none confirmed by this bounded watch, not that none occurred. A batched GitHub read hit an orchestration call cap, after which the relevant ledger records were retrieved in smaller verified batches; no source coverage was lost.
coverage_notes.controls: No approvals, publication, editorial policy changes, production queue modifications, schedule changes or disabling.
